dedupe_keys.name: smartfactory owl versatile production system measurements

description: inIT publishes measurements from the Versatile Production System at SmartFactory OWL, hosted on Kaggle. The provider explicitly identifies model learning, anomaly detection and alarm management as uses. The demonstrator moves corn through delivery, storage, dosing, bottle filling and popcorn-production modules. Conveyors, pneumatic transport, a dosing screw and load cell, rotary positioning, gripping and camera-based quality checks form the described production process. Coverage is this demonstrator; observation dates, sampling interval and detailed measurement fields are not stated in the inspected metadata. The source connects the measurements to the IMPROVE research project. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms are stated, while reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that the descriptive process sequence does not establish a complete executable simulation, measured energy balance or validated anomaly model. File format and sample count remain unknown. No photographs, video, measurement files or software were requested. The record preserves the source-established production modelling role without inferring field-scale performance.
